amendment: authority-auditor-pilot-v1-deepseek.1: versioned amendment to the frozen DeepSeek protocol (agent-tracer f87b847; freeze record in results commit 7706321f), made 2026-10-09 after seeing data (the amendment config's data_seen_before_amendment: D01-D07 with D03, the ADI baseline, and existing batch-2 output; data-read statement U4 open). Exploratory, not pre-registered; ADI-derived rows are never compared with D03's 7/19 or ADI's 53/108.
about: Amendment authority-auditor-pilot-v1-deepseek.1 stages of the ARGUS case runner on an ADI-derived case file. Run with run-stage --artifact argus --config <adapters>/argus/stages.adi.json --artifact-root <ARGUS checkout> --set cases=<file> --set cases_sha256=<LF sha256>. Agent temperature: the artifact's, as AL-S2-SS (PROT X-3; amendment ADI-X-8: no --agent-temperature). The ADI-derived case file (h2-cases/v2 contract plus top-level tool_output_format, seed_family ADI, arms ATTACK and CLEAN) is generated outside the repo into the results checkout; pass --set cases=<path> and --set cases_sha256=<LF sha256 of that file> (the runner refuses any other file).

cost_basis.source: the amendment config's cost_basis (packages/agentdojo-lab/configs/pilot_protocol_v1_deepseek_amendment_1.json; DEEPSEEK-FREEZE-V1-AMENDMENT-1.md section 2): low base D02 2,072,618 tokens / 286 episodes = 7.2k per undefended episode; high base PILOT-PROTOCOL-V1-DRAFT 9.1 per-suite means x 1.3 for the JSON formatter (guess, UNVERIFIED); auditor-to-undefended ratios from the frozen D14, D16 and AL-S2-SS estimates; prices $0.34-0.40/M blended, $0.332/M for ARGUS; PAA $0.0185-0.0488 per unit (D20)
cost_basis.cross_check: cost_basis.cross_check_d05_d07 of the same config: measured MELON 1.39x (D05), AttriGuard 3.07x per 2-row stimulus (D06), ARGUS 28.1x per 2-row stimulus with Warrant at 10.0x the none row (D07), each at or below the high ratio used; transfer to ADI cases UNVERIFIED
cost_basis.caps: generated from the config's experiments[] (cap and run block) by common/adi_stages.py write and checked by common/adi_stages.py check (G-ADI-STAGES); never edit them by hand
cost_basis.cases: dev split only (frozen eval protection, PROT 8.4; U2 keep): at most the 8 stock-expressible dev cases, and only those that pass G-ADI-CONF at export (the export report is the source of the count)
cost_basis.status: every estimate UNVERIFIED; the guard caps are the only bound

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: deepseek-flash replaces gpt-4o-mini as the agent and as every Warrant judge (published targets used gpt-4o-mini)

ADI-S1.description: Warrant gate smoke on ADI: the first 3 eligible (dev-split) ADI cases x ATTACK, CLEAN x 1, rows none and warrant, agent at the artifact's temperature (ADI-X-8) (12 episodes).

estimate.tokens: about 0.46M-1.32M (6 x 11 x 7k; 6 x 11 x 20k; UNVERIFIED)
estimate.note: the S1 estimates are bounded by the frozen S1 ones (6 stimuli vs 8; FRZ-A1 section 3)

ADI-S1.compares_to: gate AL-S1 -> AL-S2 criteria of argus/README.md on ADI: no run_error, judge_failure_episodes about 0, CLEAN warrant legitimate, tokens per warrant episode within the high estimate, components_located true for the ATTACK payload

ADI-S2.description: Warrant (W-code) as an online gate on every eligible (dev-split) ADI case x ATTACK, CLEAN x 2 repeats at the artifact's temperature (ADI-X-8; 1 repeat under the pre-registered Gate S1-ADI fallback), rows none and warrant. Resume with -- --resume-from <ADI-S1 run>/adapter.

estimate.usd: about 2.08-5.97 guard (ACFG experiments D30; cache hits charged as misses; UNVERIFIED)

ADI-S2.compares_to: approval and blame (argument-level blame class, x_action_dep) on ADI; false blocks on CLEAN; ASR_d - ASR_0 against the none row of the same run; ARGUS blame (EA3) is undefined for the cases whose payload and native X share a Warrant span under JSON (ADI-X-12, design.argus_span_separated false)
